mapper.select: SELECT * FROM reconciliation_task WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM reconciliation_task WHERE active_dedupe_scope = #{dedupeScope} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM reconciliation_task WHERE status = 'pending' AND next_execute_at <= NOW(3) ORDER BY next_execute_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE reconciliation_task SET status = 'running', updated_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'pending'
UPDATE reconciliation_task SET status = 'succeeded', execution_duration_ms = #{executionDurationMs}, last_error = NULL, updated_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'running'

UPDATE reconciliation_task SET status = 'pending', retry_count = #{retryCount}, next_execute_at = #{nextExecuteAt}, execution_duration_ms = #{executionDurationMs}, last_error = #{lastError}, updated_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'running'
UPDATE reconciliation_task SET status = 'dead', execution_duration_ms = #{executionDurationMs}, last_error = #{lastError}, updated_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'running'
UPDATE reconciliation_task SET status = 'pending', retry_count = 0, next_execute_at = NOW(3), execution_duration_ms = NULL, last_error = NULL, updated_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'dead'
UPDATE reconciliation_task SET status = 'pending', updated_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'running'
